assumptions.benchmarks: Buy and hold is included for every selection and enters after the same warmup. Cash remains uninvested and earns zero.
assumptions.costs: Fees apply to filled notional, and adverse slippage applies to the quoted open on both sides.
assumptions.drawdown: Daily path uses the running full-period peak. Each period summary resets its peak to opening equity.
assumptions.execution: Apply the prior close target at the next observed open. Mark remaining shares at the final close.
assumptions.metric_units: Returns, drawdowns and exposure are fractions. Turnover sums quoted traded notional divided by pre-trade equity.
assumptions.periods: Carry shares and cash through train, validation and test. Each period starts from previous close equity.
assumptions.selection: All parameters and portfolios are fixed by the supplied specification before calculation.
assumptions.signal: Long when the completed close exceeds its trailing simple mean. Flat during warmup and on equality.
assumptions.sizing: Invest all available cash in fractional shares, including the buy fee. Close the position on a flat target.
